purpose: Investigate six follow-up areas and distinguish useful new articles from improvements to existing work.
scope: Research and recommendations. No public article, image, player, PDF or live site changed.

basis.method: Institutional and participant sources preferred; fresh direct reads distinguished from indexed evidence and retained research. Original films, books and archival issues were not presumed viewed.

recommended_work_order: Basanta Kumari KB expansion and writer crosslinks
Kalindi and other writer profiles with broader biographical research
Suna Sansara only when original evidence or carefully scoped testimony use is resolved
narrative_thread: A writer gives an experience words; performers and filmmakers give it voice and form; people learn through shared work; recordings, books and archives allow new encounters. Ask how these relationships can also support paid creative livelihoods, without inferring undocumented earnings or presenting a universal causal sequence.
